## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Verification

List the realistic prompts, installation checks, or artifact reviews you performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The skill directory and frontmatter `name` match.
- [ ] The description clearly distinguishes when the skill should activate.
- [ ] New references or resources are linked from `SKILL.md` where needed.
- [ ] Imported or adapted work retains its license and attribution.
- [ ] The README catalog reflects added, removed, or renamed skills.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] `npx skills add . --list` and `git diff --check` succeed.
